canonical_project: Tikrit University centralized institutional data center
owner: Tikrit University / Simmons University / IREX / U.S. Department of State
notes: Simmons University announced an IREX/U.S. Department of State grant to assist Tikrit University with establishing a centralized data center for institutional data and research. This may be a university data repository/server environment rather than a commercial colocation facility; no completion or capacity found.
